mechanism: {{strategy}}: The cognitive act of splitting a {{task}} into independent subordinate parts. Criterion: solving each constituent {{problem}} in isolation must yield {{solution}} to the whole. If subproblems interact, the split is wrong—try a different decomposition axis. Recurse until subproblems are trivial.
failure_modes: Coupling Leakage: Subproblems are not truly independent; solving one breaks another.
invariants: States the independence criterion it claims, and the split satisfies the criterion it declared.
postconditions: Set of subproblems, each satisfying the declared independence criterion.
